facts.fact: Benin Web TV reports that since 24 November 2026 borrowers on the government's National Financial Inclusion Platform (PNIF) log in with their personal identification number (NPI) and confirm their identity with a code sent by SMS.
facts.system: PNIF NPI login with SMS code

systems.owner: Government, with the National Microfinance Fund

BEN.note: No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
No central bank role is stated.
A contract withdrawal period is mentioned, but no consumer-protection rules for digital finance or complaints body are stated.
No e-commerce or electronic transactions law is mentioned.
Loans paid to people are not government payments to people.
No count or share of people holding the ID is stated.
No number at birth is mentioned.
Who operates or owns the ID system is not stated.
The platform uses the NPI to log in, but no public register keyed on it is stated.
The NPI is used for login, but nothing is stated on the ID system's issuance, biometrics or certification.
No survey share of adults with accounts is stated.
Loan payouts to bank or mobile-money accounts are not person-to-person or retail payments.
No tax or fee payment is mentioned.
